Name: Early Development Abigail 2
Author: Dinivateres
Description:
This mod changes all of Abigail's sprites (overworld and portraits) to an early development version as seen on the [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/mediawiki/images/6/64/Abigail_Timeline.png]wiki[/url]﻿, with green hair. This version is more vanilla style friendly.

See also: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8028]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8028[/url]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].

Made for Stardew Valley v1.6[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]
[/url]
